proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our old shower had been leaking into the hallway closet for who knows how long. They showed us the rotten board behind the tile, then filled the new pan with water overnight before setting a single tile. Dry ever since.
reviews.name: Graciela V.

reviews.text: Every morning I got a text with a photo of what was done that day. Orange membrane, then the flood test, then tile. I never had to wonder.
reviews.name: Ignacio R.

reviews.text: We pulled up carpet in our 1958 block house and found the slab was a mess. They ground the high spots and leveled the low ones before the 24x48s went down. Not one edge sticks up.
reviews.name: Lourdes F.

reviews.text: Small job, two cracked tiles by the back door. Yesenia's guy still checked why they cracked before replacing them. Matched the old tile from a box in our garage.
reviews.name: Andrew K.

reviews.text: The grout in our guest bath was black no matter how much I scrubbed. They cut it all out, regrouted with a tighter grout and sealed it. Six months of humid summer later it still looks new.
reviews.name: Marisela T.

reviews.text: Tub walls were soft to the touch. They opened it up, dried it out, and rebuilt it with a membrane before the tile. Took five days, as promised on the first visit.
reviews.name: Desmond L.

proof.guarantee: If water gets through a shower we waterproofed, we open it up and fix it at no cost for 5 years.
